groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.text: Adele read the article about Bitublocks because

options.t: it'll help her write an assignment.
she has to present it at a seminar.
it's on her dissertation topic.

questions.text: What does Adele think is the most innovative aspect of the manufacture of Bitublocks?

options.t: It uses entirely recycled materials.
It does not involve a chemical reaction.
It is such a simple process.

questions.text: Ray was surprised to read that the Bitublocks are so

options.t: stable.
light.
absorbent.

questions.text: What do both Adele and Ray say about the manufacture of Bitublocks?

options.t: Existing methods are used.
Cheap materials are used.
Only local materials are used.

questions.text: What insight did Ray get from reading about the hospital building?

options.t: how quickly UK building projects are growing
how poor UK construction materials are
how much material the UK construction industry uses

questions.text: Adele thinks the research into the hospital was included in the article to show

options.t: how much recycled material is currently used.
ways to improve the levels of recycling.
problems caused when using recycled materials.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO things make Veggieblocks different from Bitublocks?

options.t: They are cheaper to produce.
They have a more acceptable colour.
They are simpler to manufacture.
They have problems with their smell.
They can be more easily covered.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO things about the future of the construction industry do Adele and Ray agree on?

options.t: Architects will be willing to use new materials.
Bitublocks will have a major impact.
The industry will change very fast.
Veggieblocks will become very popular.
Financial incentives will be an important influence.
